primary_route: Calibrated forced reverse gamma rotation in isolated F1 with ADP/phosphate and direct ATP measurement; motion, direction, enzyme and analytical controls.

checks.quote: # Mechanistically Interrogating Reversibility of the F1 Chemical–Mechanical Link
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of primary Methods, supplements or validated mechanical-manipulation/ATP-assay protocols with verification of transfer to this system.

checks.quote: No ADP/Pᵢ
checks.reason: Combined substrate omission does not establish independent phosphate requirement or exclude ADP-dependent contaminating ATP production.

checks.quote: Pre-treat all synthesis-buffer components with apyrase
checks.reason: Apyrase also hydrolyzes ADP. Treating all synthesis-buffer components without remeasuring/restoring the required ADP substrate can deplete the synthesis reagent; removal/inactivation of apyrase does not restore it.

checks.quote: Contamination (M2) cannot produce direction-dependence or substrate-dependence
checks.reason: The blanket exclusion is too strong: manipulation-dependent release or a substrate-dependent contaminating reaction can yield structured signals. They require identifying controls and mass balance, not this categorical assertion.

checks.quote: exact concentrations are **proposed parameters requiring empirical validation**
checks.reason: Essential ADP/Pi/free-magnesium and reaction conditions lack concrete calibration-to-choice rules; proposed buffer/speed/duration examples leave these prerequisites unresolved.

checks.quote: converted to ATP via the calibration curve
checks.reason: A static reporter standard curve, even repeated midway, does not quantify production during ATP-consuming luciferase detection. Reporter kinetic balance, recovery acceptance and calibration failure rules are missing.

checks.quote: # Mechanistically Interrogating Reversibility of the F1 Chemical–Mechanical Link
checks.reason: Fixed counts do not have a pilot-variance, meaningful-effect and precision/power justification; the alternative chamber/single-molecule units need a defined allocation hierarchy.

checks.quote: # Mechanistically Interrogating Reversibility of the F1 Chemical–Mechanical Link

checks.quote: the angle signal lacks the ±120° step structure
checks.reason: Failure to resolve 120-degree steps under continuous forcing is not proof of drift. The positive decision also lacks initial bound-pool inventory and repeated net product beyond release; a negative is not conditioned on adequate sensitivity and retained catalytic function.

checks.quote: Alternatively a fluorescent ADP:ATP ratio sensor
checks.reason: An alternative sensor is named but no independent, operational product-identity/net-synthesis validation is required for the primary claim. A ratio sensor alone also needs its own ATP/ADP calibration and specificity.

checks.quote: # Mechanistically Interrogating Reversibility of the F1 Chemical–Mechanical Link
